work_unit.title: 建立交付证据与领域不变量差距矩阵
work_unit.goal: 核对 G1、G2.0 至 G2.6 的仓库记录、运行时事实和领域不变量，形成不虚构完成度的 G2.7 基线。

codebase_context.existing_pattern: Each governed target carries target metadata, canonical spec or plan, append-only timeline, task-scoped run evidence, review, and immutable commit references.
forbidden_changes: Do not change historical target status, review, acceptance, or ship records.
Do not modify product code, schemas, migrations, tests, or runtime database facts.
Do not rewrite git history or reinterpret missing evidence as passed evidence.
Do not claim G1, G2, or G2.7 complete from fixture, mock, seed, or undocumented observation.

execution_constraints.ownership: If another change touches an allowed file or changes referenced evidence during execution, stop and reconcile rather than overwrite it.

tdd_plan.reason: T001 is an artifact-only evidence audit and does not change product behavior.

commands: for file in .verrail/targets/*/timeline.jsonl; do jq -e . "$file" >/dev/null || exit 1; done
reference_checks: Every matrix assertion names an existing file, commit, command output, or runtime fact.
Every missing fact is labeled missing rather than inferred.
Fixtures, fake connectors, and manual seeds are labeled non-production evidence.

required_items: implemented, partial, and missing finding counts

checks: No historical user decision was altered
T002 candidates are bounded and evidence-backed

stop_conditions: Technical plan and work graph are not explicitly approved.
The worktree contains a conflicting change in an allowed output file.
A referenced status or commit cannot be verified.
The audit would require changing a user-owned approval or acceptance decision.
The task expands into product implementation or runtime data repair.
